mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in HOUST (demand) indices over the past 3 months predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in expanding periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in UNRATE above 4.0% percent in a month triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In a period of rising UNRATE above 4%, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) despite the trigger occurring.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Concurrent growth in GDPC1 and INDPRO does not predict significant positive returns (p > 0.05) in 20-day horizon, or the effect is reversed in interaction tests.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, FEDFUNDS decline does not lead to significantly positive returns (p > 0.05) over 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) indices predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Sustained GDPC1 growth does not correlate with significantly positive 60-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected monthly rise in CPIAUCSL above 2.5% triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, the 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Declining unemployment (UNRATE) coupled with rising demand (GDPC1) indices predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Declining UNRATE and rising GDPC1 do not predict significantly positive returns (p > 0.05) over 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a sustained increase in FEDFUNDS predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In post-shock recovery, FEDFUNDS rise does not lead to significantly positive returns (p > 0.05) over 20 days.
